name: InfluxDB
description: InfluxDB is an open-source, high-performance time series database packaged with Chronograf, the official web-based visualization tool. Built specifically for handling high-frequency data, InfluxDB excels at managing and analyzing large volumes of timestamped information.
author: InfluxData
